explanation: This function shows the core optimization heuristics in Turbofan tiering decisions. Key thresholds and filters include: 1) maglev_filter and turbo_filter for selective optimization, 2) max_optimized_bytecode_size (60KB default) limiting large functions, 3) EfficiencyMode and BatterySaverMode disabling optimizations, 4) profile_guided_optimization with cached_tiering_decision for early/late tiering, 5) invocation_count_for_turbofan threshold with efficiency_mode_delay_turbofan_multiply factor. These heuristics explain why certain functions may never get optimized during fuzzing - e.g., functions too large, filtered out, or not reaching invocation thresholds.
